installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /mnt/server
mkdir -p /mnt/server/data

rm -rf /mnt/server/.git /mnt/server/.next /mnt/server/src /mnt/server/open-sse /mnt/server/packages /mnt/server/electron /mnt/server/node_modules /mnt/server/package.json /mnt/server/package-lock.json /mnt/server/.built_commit

cat << 'EOF' > /mnt/server/start.sh
#!/bin/bash
set -e

cd /home/container
mkdir -p /home/container/data

export NODE_ENV=production
export PORT=${SERVER_PORT}
export OMNIROUTE_PORT=${SERVER_PORT}
export HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0
export OMNIROUTE_SERVER_HOST=0.0.0.0
export DATA_DIR=/home/container/data
export HOME=/home/container
export NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX=/home/container/.npm-global
export PATH="/home/container/.npm-global/bin:$PATH"
export NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=${MEMORY_MB}"

# Auto-generate secrets into .env on first boot if still blank
if [ ! -f .env ]; then
    touch .env
fi

if [ -z "$JWT_SECRET" ] && ! grep -q "^JWT_SECRET=" .env; then
    echo "JWT_SECRET=$(node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(48).toString('base64'))")" >> .env
fi

if [ -z "$API_KEY_SECRET" ] && ! grep -q "^API_KEY_SECRET=" .env; then
    echo "API_KEY_SECRET=$(node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))")" >> .env
fi

set -a
source .env
set +a

INSTALLED_VER=$(node -e "try{console.log(require('/home/container/.npm-global/lib/node_modules/omniroute/package.json').version)}catch(e){}" 2>/dev/null || echo "")

if [ -z "$INSTALLED_VER" ] || [ "$AUTO_UPDATE" = "true" ]; then
    echo "[OmniRoute] Installing prebuilt omniroute@${OMNIROUTE_VERSION} package..."
    npm install -g "omniroute@${OMNIROUTE_VERSION}" --no-audit --no-fund
fi

echo "[OmniRoute] Starting prebuilt gateway and dashboard on 0.0.0.0:${PORT}..."
exec omniroute --port "${PORT}"
EOF

chmod +x /mnt/server/start.sh
echo "OmniRoute prebuilt launcher installed."

variables.name: OmniRoute npm Version
variables.description: npm dist-tag or exact version of the prebuilt omniroute package (e.g., latest or 3.8.53).

variables.name: Auto-Update on Boot
variables.description: Set to true to check and install the specified OMNIROUTE_VERSION every time the server starts.

variables.name: Require API Key on /v1/*
variables.description: Enforce generated virtual API keys for all proxy requests (strongly recommended).

variables.name: Node Heap Limit (MB)
variables.description: V8 max-old-space-size in MB. 768 MB works comfortably inside a 1024-1536 MB container.

variables.name: JWT Secret
variables.description: Session signing secret. Leave blank to auto-generate a secure 48-byte key in .env on first start.

variables.name: API Key Secret
variables.description: Encryption/signing secret for generated virtual API keys. Leave blank to auto-generate on first start.

variables.name: Initial Dashboard Password
variables.description: Optional initial admin password for the web UI (if unset, set it on first visit in the browser).

variables.name: Disable SQLite Auto-Backup
variables.description: Set to true if you handle backups externally via Pterodactyl panel backups.
